summary: KNOREX Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an Extraordinary General Meeting held on June 24, 2026, where shareholders voted with ~99.996% approval to remove director Wilson Chandra, effective immediately, and elect three new directors: Kai Zhong, Lu Liu, and Truong Vinh Phu Le. Following the EGM, the Board placed Mr. Chandra on administrative leave from his role as President. The board reconstituted committees, designating Mr. Liu as audit committee financial expert. This forced removal and abrupt departure of a director/president constitutes a management change event. The filing notes the board now consists of five directors, with three new appointees. Watch for any subsequent strategic initiatives or operational shifts.
